pairs.name: launch_rise_low_angle
pairs.note: T1 @127.2 s (the owner's copy carries player icons). RULING PENDING (review item 3a): at the film's luma 15-18, a darkest-quarter blue minus red of +15 or more needs more saturation than the band allows, and the film's own darkest quarter here is only +6 to +9. Following the film (the task's rule), blue minus red is measured in the wide and case shots only, and the rise background takes about 15% less saturation (done: 0.72-0.83x). Under the design's rule these regions would add b_minus_r_dark [15, 25]; ours measure +10 to +11.
